zh.title: 國防部偵獲共艦與公務船共11艘擾台 期間無共機
zh.summary: 國防部統計台海周邊偵獲共艦7艘與公務船4艘；期間未偵獲中共軍機動態。
body: 台灣國防部於2026年8月25日上午發布最新中共機艦動態資訊。統計顯示，自8月24日上午6時至8月25日上午6時的24小時內，國軍共偵獲7艘中共軍艦及4艘公務船持續在台灣海峽周邊海域進行活動。
國防部指出，在此次24小時監測期間內，並未偵獲任何中共軍機進入周邊空域。面對中共艦艇的持續活動，國軍均保持高度警覺並即時掌控相關動態。
針對台海周邊海空域狀況，國防部強調國軍已充分運用任務機、艦艇以及岸置飛彈系統，實施嚴密監控與妥善應處，以維護區域安全。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 7 PLA Warships and 4 Official Vessels Near Island; No Aircraft Spotted
en.summary: Taiwan detects seven Chinese warships and four official vessels near the island, with zero military aircraft reported.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on August 25, 2026, that seven Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy warships and four official vessels were detected operating in the waters around Taiwan over a 24-hour monitoring period. The tracking period spanned from 06:00 on August 24 to 06:00 on August 25.

According to the defense ministry statement, no Chinese military aircraft were detected around Taiwan during the same timeframe. Taiwan's armed forces closely monitored the situation and responded accordingly using combat aircraft, naval vessels, and shore-based missile defense systems to ensure surrounding airspace and maritime security.
